heading: India reacts to new US tariffs law as Russian oil remains key to energy sourcing
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: India is studying proposed US tariffs targeting nations buying Russian oil. The US House of Representatives passed legislation to increase economic pressure on Russia. This move could impact broader trade agreement discussions between India and the US. India has stressed protecting its trade and economic interests amid these developments. Russian oil remains a key part of India's energy sourcing strategy.
